sentences.text:
An Application For Bail Under Section ... vs In Re:- Manik Rui
Das on 3 July, 2017
Author: Ashim Kumar Roy

Bench: Ashim Kumar Roy
 1
 19
03.07.2017
sm Rejected Crm No.6102 of 2017 In the matter of an application for bail under Section 439 of the
Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 23.06.2017 in connection with Moyna Police Station Case
No.228 of 2015 dated 28.09.2015 under sections 272/273/304(1)/120B of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 read with section 46 Aabe Act and section 16(1A)(ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration
Act.
And In Re:- Manik Rui Das .... Petitioner (In jail) Mr.Hasibul Islam ... for the petitioner.

Mr.Sanjay
Bardhan Mr.Saryati Dutta ... for the State.
Heard the learned advocates appearing on behalf of the parties.
This is a case, where consuming adulterate spurious ID liquor, 23 persons died and many became sick.
Already the trial has commenced and out of 77 witnesses, examination of 34 witnesses is complete.

It is contended from the side of the petitioner that although in the earlier order rejecting the prayer for bail about six (6) months back, a co-ordinate Bench of this court directed that all steps should be taken to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible, preferably within six (6) months from the date of communication of this court order, but till date, the trial has not been concluded.
Be that as it may, this is not a fit case for bail.
Accordingly, this application for bail stands rejected.
The learned trial court is once again directed to conclude the trial as early as possible.
